quickCreate.title: Create
quickCreate.subtitle: Choose what to add to your community.
quickCreate.newExchangeDescription: Post an offer or request for timebank exchanges.
quickCreate.newTimebankListingDescription: Post an offer or request for timebank exchanges.
quickCreate.newMarketplaceListingDescription: List something to sell, give away for free (Freecycle), or lend to members.
quickCreate.newMessageDescription: Choose a member and start a private conversation.
quickCreate.newEventDescription: Create a community gathering, workshop, or meetup.
quickCreate.newPollDescription: Ask a question and let members vote on the options.
quickCreate.newChallengeDescription: Invite members to submit ideas for a focused community question.
quickCreate.newGroupDescription: Start a space for members with shared interests.
quickCreate.newJobDescription: Post a job vacancy for your community.
quickCreate.newVolunteeringDescription: Post shifts for an organisation you help run.
quickCreate.newOrganisationDescription: Add a group or organisation to your community.
quickCreate.newCourseDescription: Teach a skill to your community.
quickCreate.newPodcastDescription: Start a show or record an episode.
